title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds $64,559 at US close, up 0.6% while fear and greed sits at extreme fear 25. The network runs strong at 959 EH/s hashrate, signaling miner conviction even as sentiment sours. Mempool carries 91,878 transactions with fees bottomed at 5 sat/vB, showing steady demand without fee spikes.

Key takeaway: price action stays resilient above the round number despite the fear reading. Block height now 960,331 after another steady day of production.

Overnight, watch for any hashrate dips or me
